title: BigCommerce Themes
meta: Pick a proven BigCommerce theme and we tailor it to your brand: colors, fonts, layout and sections. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: A proven BigCommerce theme, tailored to your brand
overview: Not sure where to start with design? We help you choose a tried and tested BigCommerce theme, free or paid, that fits your products. Then we tailor it to your brand: your logo, colors and fonts, a home page that shows your best sellers, and the small layout details that make a stock theme feel like your own store. You get a preview link and a short guide to editing it yourself.

pkgs.blurb: A theme chosen and styled to match your brand.
Deeper tailoring with custom sections and page styling.
A fully tailored theme with extra layouts and an editing guide.

faq: Do I have to buy a paid theme?
No. BigCommerce has free themes that work well, and we can tailor one of those. If you prefer a paid one from the theme store, you buy it and we customize it for you.
Is this different from theme edits?
Yes. This is for stores starting with a stock theme and wanting a branded result. Theme edits suit stores that already have a theme and need fixes or changes to it.
Can I keep editing the theme myself?
Yes. We use the standard theme editor wherever possible and add a short guide, so you can change text, images and banners later without breaking the layout.
Will the theme work on mobile?
Yes. We check the finished store on phone and tablet sizes and fix spacing and tap targets before handover.
